title: [DocDB][LST] Corruption: Bad narrow cast in yb::DocHybridTime::DecodeFrom()
body:

This failure happened using the [Long-running System Test](https://github.com/yugabyte/yb-long-system-test/) framework I'm currently working on.

I got this fatal failure in tserver (ea58ecba35dacc1706293d72ec99b07b1ecb08f6 code state) like this, but can't reproduce:
```
$ cd ~/code/yugabyte-db
$ bin/yb-ctl --replication_factor 3 create
$ cd ~/code/yb-long-system-test
$ git checkout cbfcfcfc683948e0da00a075ee1ce2021f57bd79 && ./long_system_test.py --threads=10 --seed=385681
[...]
```
